 For the Petitioner : None
 For the Respondents : None
 For Respondent No. 5 : Mr. Mahendra Pathak, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sandeep Kumar
 Oral Order
5 21-02-2023
Heard Mr. Mahendra Pathak, learned counsel on behalf of respondent no. 5.

This application has been filed for quashing F.I.R passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Katihar in conne
ction with Katihar Nagar, P.S. Case No. 22 of 2014 for the offences under Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
The F.I.R of order dated 07.01.2014 was under challenge and there is no information about the stage of the case.
